notes.title: Syndicate robots: The Final Wave
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/2797af46ce8cfc7ff585584d48b895f25185a773.jpg[/img]

[h1]The final wave of Syndicate robots has arrived![/h1]
Our newly released patch [b]3.8.3[/b] includes the last 4 members of the new Syndicate faction, and also brings numerous balancing changes.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/4290ce26b9830886913fa7027248a0f612e123f2.png[/img]
[b]Helix[/b]
Class: Light robot specialized in electronic warfare

[i]"The Helix is a good all-rounder when it comes to electronic warfare. While it may not be the toughest bot around, combining a light chassis with an assault-class undercarriage makes it probably the fastest."[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/1817534c36781fa7db83ecd586054693bcbc8241.png[/img]
[b]Callisto[/b]
Class: Mech specialized in electronic warfare

[i]"Employing our own technologies and incorporating all the knowledge that we have gained from the Nian factions, the Callisto is an elusive and flexible mech for tackling and shutting down enemy units."[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/c5b84efc22cdb88caaf472e0285a2f342dd7702b.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/d5497dec614401fbd75303f9a379fce3e1d6c5d1.png[/img]
[b]Legatus[/b]
Class: Heavy mech specialized in firearms

[i]"Alluding on its appearance our engineers have nicknamed it "Doc". Aptly so, as the Legatus can administer a swarm of good old glowing hot bullets at a relatively long range for those in need. And that without writing out a prescription."[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/678c90628f406f9c51b91bbcd85841b19f4c3d6b.png[/img]
[b]Metis[/b]
Class: Heavy mech specialized in combat support

[i]"Exceptional energy output and defense capabilities - two traits that turn this heavy mech into an indispensable powerhouse on the battlefield. The Metis is the holy grail of remote support, which usually makes it a primary target in the eyes of enemy commanders."[/i]

[h1]Balancing changes[/h1]

The last patch introduced diminishing returns when using tuning modules in the form of exponentially increasing accumulator usage. The changes were a bit on the rough side, so in this patch we are refining this concept further and create some diversity between tuning module tiers.

The rest of the updates include NEXUS module specialization for heavy mechs, accumulator usage balancing of firearms, and an increase to the hit dispersion of medium weaponry, which increases survivability of light robots against larger robots.

[b]The above changes are detailed in our latest [url=http://blog.perpetuum-online.com/posts/2017-02-12-syndicate-robots-the-final-wave/]dev blog[/url].[/b]

ːrepairshopː [b]The full patch notes are available [url=http://www.perpetuum-online.com/Changelog:2017-02-16]here[/url].[/b]

notes.title: Patch 3.8
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/fc0eb94e658413c24ad53a0967866d1cde9b156e.jpg[/img]

[b]Patch 3.8 has been deployed today,[/b] bringing the first wave of Syndicate robots,  lighting and environment reworks, plus various fixes and improvements.

[h1][b]Syndicate robots: Wave 1[/b][/h1]

The first [b]three robots[/b] of the Syndicate faction are now available for purchase for a combination of faction tokens and NIC in the Syndicate Supplies store. For more information on Syndicate robots check out our relevant [url=http://blog.perpetuum-online.com/posts/2016-07-28-syndicate-robots-wave-1/]blog post[/url].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/dcbe3d5cac49dfb5c0c28cd449e9e07a6f6e2e91.png[/img]
[b]Vektor[/b]
Class: Light robot specialized in firearms

[i]"The smallest member of our hybrid-technology fleet of robots. Its armor is weaker than the average, but its small size makes up for it, resulting in a hard to hit target. Coupled with excellent detection and masking systems, the Vektor makes not only a good scout, but a tough opponent in combat as well."[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/40d5df459084dd3aa4c5a886231251c2bf915ce3.png[/img]
[b]Locust[/b]
Class: Assault robot specialized in firearms

[i]"The gist of our firearm-wielding force. A swarm of Locusts can quickly shred enemy groups, but their specialized framework increases their survivability in solo engagements too."[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/f4cf235d9b2f2cc8f4a3f0e4433dfd58a664bcf1.png[/img]
[b]Ikarus[/b]
Class: Light robot specialized in transportation

[i]"The Ikarus is a snappy answer to the Perpetuum Project's long-standing need for a fast and light transport. Its main element is a repurposed Argano-chassis, stripped of anything disposable to make room for the relatively large cargo hold. Aided by the agile undercarriage of the Laird, this is the most efficient robot to get fair-sized packages from A to B quickly. Speed comes at a price though, as the construction is very fragile."[/i]

[h1][b]EP boosters now affect EP rewards[/b][/h1]

Based on a forum suggestion, we have incorporated EP boosters into the EP reward system: if you have an active EP booster, any EP rewards that you receive from your ingame activities will be [b]doubled.[/b]

[h1][b]Lighting and environment tuning[/b][/h1]

The lighting, environment, and post-processing setup of the game has been revisited, to make your time on the terrain feel a bit nicer.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/126e4008003285be66c972bf9ea6352c86817bba.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4460994/aa801dc61fd39a51100054654d3e23e87e701e58.jpg[/img]

Like always, the patch includes a few other fixes and changes as well.

:repairshop: [b]The full patchnotes are available [url=http://www.perpetuum-online.com/Changelog:2016-08-04]here[/url].[/b]

notes.title: EP rewards / Summer Sale
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 3.7.6 out today[/h1]
While the system of daily EP packages remains untouched, today's patch introduces [b]new ways to acquire Extension Points[/b] on top of that. Starting immediately, killing NPCs, gathering minerals, and a few other ingame activities  will grant you varying amounts of EP.

This patch also brings an EP handicapping system, aimed to help players with low EP to catch up faster.

Check out the full patch notes here:
http://www.perpetuum-online.com/Changelog:2016-06-24

[h1]Summer Sale[/h1]
The Perpetuum base game, DLCs, bundle packs, and ingame purchases are all [b]50% OFF[/b] during the Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: Trading cards now available!
notes.content:
[img]http://content.perpetuum-online.com/images/content/trading_cards.png[/img]

If you are a Steam-dweller you probably know [url=http://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/]what these are[/url], but here is a quick recap:

Playing Perpetuum on Steam will give you trading cards from time to time (every 30 minutes of gameplay to be exact). A set consists of 5 cards, and you can get half of this (rounded up, so 3) by simply playing.

The other half (and more) can be acquired by in-game purchases (Perpetuum Credits) or via the Steam community market. (I'll quote the Steam Trading Card FAQ here: "For every $9 USD spent (approximate) (...), you will earn one card drop. This card will drop at some point as you play.")

Completing a card set will earn you a badge, a random emoticon and profile background, and other stuff.

[b]Summary:[/b]
[list]
[*] 5 trading cards
[*] 5 badge levels (plus 1 foil badge)
[*] 5 profile backgrounds (3 common, 1 uncommon, 1 rare)
[*] 10 emoticons (6 common, 3 uncommon, 1 rare)
[/list]
[i]Happy card hunting![/i]

notes.title: Patch 3.7.3
notes.content:
[h1]Token shop upgrades[/h1]
[img]http://content.perpetuum-online.com/images/content/devblog_requisition_slips.png[/img]
Today's patch brings the long-awaited upgrades to the token shop, otherwise known as [b]Syndicate Supplies[/b]:
[list]
[*] Added [b]T2+[/b] and [b]T4+[/b] items for direct purchase
[*] Added special faction robots commonly known as [b]"black robots"[/b]
[*] Added new [b]requisition slip[/b] items, which reward you with random modules, with a chance for rare tiers
[/list]
As always, the patch includes numerous fixes and smaller improvements.
The full patch notes are available here: http://www.perpetuum-online.com/Changelog:2016-02-01

notes.title: New premium packages available!
notes.content:
Today we're introducing [b]new premium packages and upgrade kits for Perpetuum.[/b] Our main goal here is to be able to reach a wider audience by permanently reducing the price of the base game, while still providing something extra for those who are willing to support us beyond that.

The upgrade kits contain varying amounts of Extension Points, Perpetuum Credits, Alien Improbability Devices, and also exclusive new sparks, and the Perpetuum original soundtrack.

These kits are organized into the above mentioned premium packages, which include the base game plus one or both of the kits - the picture below should give you a nice breakdown.

[img]http://content.perpetuum-online.com/images/content/premium_packages_poster.png[/img]

You might also notice that the base game will come with 200 credits and 1 AID from now on, in order to provide a less bumpy road for new players. 

Of course the [b]individual upgrades[/b] are also available outside of the premium packages. So if you are an older player, you can also purchase these in any combination* and enjoy the same goodies like someone getting a whole premium package for the first time as a new player. (Hence the name "Upgrade Kit".)

[i]* Each upgrade kit can be purchased only once for each Perpetuum account.[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/426280/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/426281/

[h1]Pricing[/h1]

Soon after the introduction of the premium packages, the base game (aka. "Standard Edition") will undergo a [b]permanent price reduction[/b] and will be available for only [b]9.99 USD/EUR[/b] (or the equivalent in your local currency).

Both [b]Upgrade Kits[/b] go for the same [b]9.99[/b] price tag if purchased separately, and if you decide for one of the premium packages, you'll enjoy a few bucks off on the package price compared to the individual prices. The [b]Premium Edition[/b] goes for [b]18.99[/b] (save about 5%) and the [b]Superior Edition[/b] for [b]27.99[/b] (save about 7%).

[h1]Patch 3.7.2[/h1]

In other news, patch 3.7.2 has been deployed yesterday which was mostly for the premium packages, but it also contains a few fixes. Check out the patch notes here:
http://www.perpetuum-online.com/Changelog:2015-12-18

The [b]Premium Edition[/b] goes for [b]18.99[/b] (save about 5%) and the [b]Superior Edition[/b] for [b]27.99[/b] (save about 7%).

[h1]Patch 3.7.2[/h1]

In other news, patch 3.7.2 has been deployed yesterday which was mostly for the premium packages, but it also contains a few fixes. Check out the patch notes here:
http://www.perpetuum-online.com/Changelog:2015-12-18

tags.feature: Today we're introducing [b]new premium packages and upgrade kits for Perpetuum.[/b]
The upgrade kits contain varying amounts of Extension Points, Perpetuum Credits, Alien Improbability Devices, and also exclusive new sparks, and the Perpetuum original soundtrack.
These kits are organized into the above mentioned premium packages, which include the base game plus one or both of the kits - the picture below should give you a nice breakdown.
You might also notice that the base game will come with 200 credits and 1 AID from now on, in order to provide a less bumpy road for new players.

Of course the [b]individual upgrades[/b] are also available outside of the premium packages. So if you are an older player, you can also purchase these in any combination* and enjoy the same goodies like someone getting a whole premium package for the first time as a new player. (Hence the name "Upgrade Kit".)

notes.title: Patch notes - 2014-05-06
notes.content:
Today's [b]patch[/b] brings a number of [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b] that players have been asking for. We have a brand new [b]autopilot[/b] mechanic that's lightyears better than the previous "zombiepilot", we have introduced [b]robot equipment saving and loading[/b] (and you can even send your loadouts to your friends), and a few more stuff. Oh and we also have a ****ing effective profanity filter now.
